subsetPolicyRationale: `s.norm.en1996@1` is this plugin's own self-contained Eurocode EN 1996 masonry-design document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (change-annex, change-wall-height, insert-opening, change-opening-width, insert-load-case, change-concentrated-force, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field, record or nested collection it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
